requirements.title: Explicit practical workflow preserves honest check and migration boundaries

statement.text: A schema-5 opt-in contract runs canonical checks once at the selected boundary without legacy evidence transport, rejects unsafe or stale migration, and never treats setup or saved review as product verification.

requirements.rationale: Reduce process cost while retaining explicit policy choice, current executions and safe migration; stronger external obligations remain additive.

criteria.expected: Executable tests distinguish command deduplication and real failures, stage-independent links, explicit presets, strict namespace and stale-safe migration from approval, complete adoption and remote qualification claims.
